status: HARNESS FIRST RED: INPUT PROBE READ VIC-IV REGISTERS BEFORE THE PRODUCT UNLOCK
mechanism: The fixture copied $D06C-$D06E before calling m65-sprite-shape. The product function first writes $47/$53 to $D02F and only then reads those VIC-IV registers. Therefore the recorded pointer bytes are not the values consumed by the guard, and the apparently valid inputs cannot support the pre-registered contradiction outcome.
product_claim: none; the byte-identical parity-toy still has a deterministic target VM_TYPEERROR, but this probe does not localize it

correction.rule: mirror the production unlock/read order and record sprite-number, string and pointer-geometry predicates before the call

claim_limit: A sequencing defect in a disposable diagnostic fixture. No product byte, Link-89 candidate or release artifact changed.
